The '''Ralltiir underground''' referred to the local [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] resistance on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|subjugation]] of the planet in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Members of the underground included [[Pharl McQuarrie/Legends|Pharl McQuarrie]] and [[Jeroen Webb]], both of whom would go on to join the Alliance to Restore the Republic proper. Thanks largely due to McQuarrie's efforts, the Ralltiir underground helped pass along [[Death Star plans/Legends|information]] regarding the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], eventually resulting in the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] destruction at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
